scenario_description: A legitimate incident exists and was investigated, but it does not match agent-runtime-service's own deterministic remediation policy (severity is 'warning', not 'critical') -- propose_remediation must create NOTHING and the run must finalize normally with remediation_status='not_applicable'.

provenance.notes: Drives the REAL agent_runtime_service.graph.build.compile_graph/graph.nodes.propose_remediation through evals.fakes.doubles -- the incident/report fixtures are synthetic, but the policy logic being exercised is the real, unmodified production function.

ground_truth_rationale: agent_runtime_service.graph.nodes.propose_remediation's own deterministic policy requires severity=='critical' among its conditions (see REMEDIATION_ACTION_TYPE policy match in graph/nodes.py). A 'warning' severity incident must never produce a proposal, regardless of how convincing its investigation looks -- this is a hard safety invariant, not a quality preference.
forbidden_outcomes: any proposal creation (control_plane.create_calls >= 1) for a non-critical-severity incident
reaching the await_human_approval interrupt for an ineligible incident
